review_note: An exact left resolution of complexes plus exactness on cochain cycles gives a quasi-isomorphism Tot(A)→M. Matched against the pinned original theorem text in the Stage A source packet; did not open proof/remark text. Preliminary decision only.
statement:
Let $M^\bullet$ be a complex of abelian groups. Let
$$
\ldots \to A_2^\bullet \to A_1^\bullet \to A_0^\bullet \to M^\bullet \to 0
$$
be an exact complex of complexes of abelian groups such that for all
$p \in \mathbf{Z}$ the complexes
$$
\ldots \to \Ker(d_{A_2^\bullet}^p) \to \Ker(d_{A_1^\bullet}^p)
\to \Ker(d_{A_0^\bullet}^p) \to \Ker(d_{M^\bullet}^p) \to 0
$$
are exact as well. Set $A^{p, q} = A_{-p}^q$ to obtain a double
complex. Then $\text{Tot}(A^{\bullet, \bullet}) \to M^\bullet$
induced by $A_0^\bullet \to M^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism.
hypotheses: Let $\cdots\to A_2^\bullet\to A_1^\bullet\to A_0^\bullet\to M^\bullet\to0$ be exact in cochain complexes of abelian groups and suppose, in each degree $p$, the induced sequence of differential kernels is exact.
conclusions: The natural map $\operatorname{Tot}(A^{p,q}=A_{-p}^q)\to M^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-good-resolution-gives-qis}
Let $M^\bullet$ be a complex of abelian groups. Let
$$
\ldots \to A_2^\bullet \to A_1^\bullet \to A_0^\bullet \to M^\bullet \to 0
$$
be an exact complex of complexes of abelian groups such that for all
$p \in \mathbf{Z}$ the complexes
$$
\ldots \to \Ker(d_{A_2^\bullet}^p) \to \Ker(d_{A_1^\bullet}^p)
\to \Ker(d_{A_0^\bullet}^p) \to \Ker(d_{M^\bullet}^p) \to 0
$$
are exact as well. Set $A^{p, q} = A_{-p}^q$ to obtain a double
complex. Then $\text{Tot}(A^{\bullet, \bullet}) \to M^\bullet$
induced by $A_0^\bullet \to M^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism.
